# PDFEDI

> PDFEDI is a free online PDF toolkit. 19 PDF tools plus a full in-browser PDF editor.
> No sign-up, no watermarks. Files are processed securely and deleted automatically.
> Each tool is free up to 5 times per hour; max file size 50MB.

## PDF Editor

- [PDF Editor](https://pdfedi.onrender.com/editor): Edit PDF text directly, add images and shapes, sign documents, redact content — all in the browser. Files stay on the device.

## Organize

- [Merge PDF](https://pdfedi.onrender.com/tools/merge): Combine 2–20 PDFs into one document.
- [Split PDF](https://pdfedi.onrender.com/tools/split): Split a PDF by page ranges or into individual pages (ZIP download).
- [Rotate Pages](https://pdfedi.onrender.com/tools/rotate_pages): Rotate pages 90°, 180° or 270°, all pages or selected ranges.
- [Delete Pages](https://pdfedi.onrender.com/tools/delete_pages): Remove pages by number or range.
- [Reorder Pages](https://pdfedi.onrender.com/tools/reorder_pages): Rearrange pages into any order.

## Convert

- [Extract Text](https://pdfedi.onrender.com/tools/extract_text): Extract text from a PDF to a .txt file.
- [PDF to Images](https://pdfedi.onrender.com/tools/pdf_to_images): Convert PDF pages to PNG or JPG (72–300 DPI, ZIP download).
- [Images to PDF](https://pdfedi.onrender.com/tools/images_to_pdf): Combine JPG, PNG or WebP images into one PDF.
- [Thumbnails](https://pdfedi.onrender.com/tools/thumbnails): Page thumbnail contact sheet as a PNG image.
- [OCR](https://pdfedi.onrender.com/tools/ocr): Make scanned PDFs searchable with an invisible text layer.

## Edit

- [View Metadata](https://pdfedi.onrender.com/tools/metadata): Inspect PDF metadata (title, author, dates, page count) as JSON.
- [Edit Metadata](https://pdfedi.onrender.com/tools/edit_metadata): Update PDF title, author, subject and keywords.
- [Watermark](https://pdfedi.onrender.com/tools/watermark): Stamp diagonal text (e.g. DRAFT, CONFIDENTIAL) with adjustable opacity.
- [Page Numbers](https://pdfedi.onrender.com/tools/page_numbers): Add page numbers with custom position, start number and font size.

## Optimize

- [Compress PDF](https://pdfedi.onrender.com/tools/compress): Reduce PDF file size with three quality levels.

## Security

- [Protect PDF](https://pdfedi.onrender.com/tools/password_protect): Add password encryption to a PDF.
- [Unlock PDF](https://pdfedi.onrender.com/tools/unlock_pdf): Remove password protection with the correct password.
- [Redact](https://pdfedi.onrender.com/tools/redact): Permanently black out sensitive text by exact match.
- [Flatten PDF](https://pdfedi.onrender.com/tools/flatten): Bake annotations and form fields permanently into pages.

## Privacy

- Server-side tool uploads are processed and deleted automatically; no account required.
- The PDF editor runs in the browser; files stay on the user's device.
- Admin (`/admin`) and API (`/api/`) routes are not public content.
